values: Start with one workflow, one owner, and one success metric. Expansion should follow evidence, not enthusiasm. A focused pilot beats a scattered roadmap because it produces proof points that stakeholders can verify. If this matches your current initiative, the next step is a short scoping call and a concrete pilot plan.
